svg.title: Indeed the centered indicators are martingale differences of range one. Conditional Hoeffding and exponential Markov give each two-sided failure at most 2e−2nu(n)2 = α/(π2n2K). Summing over n gives α/(6K) for each stream; union over 6K streams proves the claim. Predictable sampling can be handled by stopping each stream at its observed sample index, or appending zero centered increments after its finite budget ends. No iid outcome law is required.
